literalGroups.individualGround: OCLC §4.3 explicitly lists 800 Literature and 900 History & geography; §4.12–4.13 explain their scope. The question asks this pair of three-digit main classes, not just a ten-class architecture shared with UDC. LCC’s H/Q letters are different; UDC lists 8 Linguistics/Literature and 9 Geography/History rather than the specified DDC three-digit main-class pair; Colon’s PMEST synthesis is not that class table. Only DDC satisfies the entire predicate.
